scope: Bounded re-review of two previously reported correctness defects

results.title: Clearing an imported default flow leaves the old default in XML
evidence: Imported/default-managed flow nodes carry defaultFlowManaged state, and updateElement sets it true when defaultFlow is explicitly cleared.
BpmnDocument.reconcileConditionalAndDefaultFlows clears elementSemantic.default when defaultFlowManaged is true before applying any current defaultFlow at src/core/BpmnDocument.ts:880-899.

tests/unit/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.test.ts:864-896 reopens a persisted diagram, reassigns its default, clears with defaultFlow:null, parses exported XML to assert the moddle default is absent, then reopens again and asserts typed defaultFlow remains absent.
tests/integration/handlers.test.ts:243-249 clears defaultFlow through update_element and asserts the live XML no longer contains the source default reference.

results.title: Non-boolean isDefault values can silently create default flows
evidence: SimpleBpmnEngine.connect rejects every defined isDefault whose runtime type is not boolean before resolving endpoints or mutating state at src/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.ts:189-193.
BpmnRequestHandler.connect forwards only the canonical isDefault value to the engine at src/server/handlers.ts:359-376, so MCP inputs cannot bypass the runtime guard through alias normalization.
tests/unit/core/SimpleBpmnEngine.test.ts:918-921 asserts a string isDefault rejects and leaves the connection map empty.
tests/integration/handlers.test.ts:252-261 sends isDefault as a string through the MCP handler, asserts an error, and verifies that no connection was created.

residual_risks: ProcessContext maps remain directly mutable, so callers bypassing engine mutation methods can still create inconsistent default-flow state; this is outside the two bounded defects.
The focused non-boolean tests use a string example, although the single typeof guard also rejects numbers, objects, arrays, and null is treated as non-boolean when supplied.
